rationale: No existing spec covers the Profiles left-rail menu gate. The two closest specs (status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js, edition-features.spec.js) demonstrate the exact pattern to reuse — detect the gate's source value from the live /api/{org}/config response and test.skip() when the environment can't reach the alternate state — but they test different features (Status Pages dropdown gating, Edition upsell dialog). The run-context names a dedicated spec path (tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/GeneralTests/profilesMenu.spec.js) under GeneralTests. This is a new spec and must be registered in ci_matrix.json's GeneralTests run_files (it is not there today; neither status-pages-enterprise-gating nor any profiles spec is present).
